national_news.title: Calcutta HC cancels all OBC certificates issued under revised rules by previous state govt
bullets: Calcutta High Court cancels OBC certificates issued under OBC-A and OBC-B classifications introduced by the previous Trinamool Congress government.
Holders of these certificates will now be treated as belonging to the general category.
The controversy dates back to 2010, when the state divided OBC communities into two classifications.

national_news.title: IMD forecasts extremely heavy rainfall in Odisha and Gangetic West Bengal today
bullets: IMD issued a red colour warning for heavy to very heavy rainfall over Gangetic West Bengal and Odisha.
Heavy rainfall is expected to prevail over several states including Jammu and Kashmir, Ladakh, and East Uttar Pradesh.
A low-pressure area has formed over the North Bay of Bengal, leading to the extreme weather conditions.

national_news.title: 199 Parliament passes bill to enhance funding and development of cooperative sector
bullets: The National Co-operative Development Corporation (NCDC) (Amendment) Bill, 2026 has been passed by Parliament.
The Bill aims to further amend the National Co-operative Development Corporation Act, 1962.
The legislation allows the Corporation to undertake activities in industrial goods and provide loans and grants directly to co-operatives.

national_news.title: India to host Afghanistan for a three-match T20 International series in September
bullets: The series will be played at the Arun Jaitley Cricket Stadium in Delhi from 13 to 17th September.
The series is part of Afghanistan's Future Tours Program.
BCCI remains committed to supporting the growth of cricket in Afghanistan.

national_news.title: Thailand Elevates School Safety to National Agenda After Fatal Shooting
bullets: Thailand's cabinet approved an Education Ministry's proposal to elevate school safety to a national agenda.
The move aims to strengthen prevention and response at educational institutions systematically.
All schools have been designated School Safety Zones and must set up centres for protection of rights, liberties, and safety.

national_news.title: India wins 3 gold, 1 silver, and 1 bronze in Commonwealth Fencing Championship
bullets: India won 3 gold, 1 silver, and 1 bronze medal in the Commonwealth Fencing Championship.
The championship is being held at Lagos in Nigeria.
India's overall combined medal count is now 29, comprising 8 Gold, 7 Silver, and 14 Bronze.

national_news.title: Sports Ministry suspends TTFI's recognition till restoration of its governance structure
bullets: The Sports Ministry suspended the recognition of the Table Tennis Federation of India (TTFI) due to governance deficiencies.
The Ministry cited TTFI's failure to conduct elections on time as one of the reasons for the suspension.
An ad-hoc committee will be formed by the Indian Olympic Association to administer the sport.

national_news.title: Indian Grandmaster R Praggnanandhaa defeats Javokhir Sindarov in Sinquefield Cup
bullets: Indian Grandmaster R Praggnanandhaa secured his first victory in the Sinquefield Cup.
The match was a part of the Grand Chess Tour, with the Sinquefield Cup being the penultimate event.
Praggnanandhaa dominated the game from start to finish, eventually turning the endgame in his favor.

national_news.title: BRICS economies are major growth engines of global economy, says FM Sitharaman
bullets: BRICS economies are major growth engines of the global economy.
Public capital should act as a catalyst for private investment, not a substitute.
BRICS economies face challenges in attracting private capital, requiring investor confidence, stability, and predictability.

national_news.title: India's retail inflation rises to 4.45%, remains above RBI's target of 4%
bullets: Retail inflation accelerated to 4.45% in July, above RBI's target of 4% for the second consecutive month.
Food prices remained elevated, contributing to the higher inflation reading.
Inflation in rural areas increased to 4.84%, higher than the overall retail inflation rate.

national_news.title: Financial Inclusion in India: Banking Every Citizen, Empowering Every Household
bullets: India has expanded access to banking, digital payments, credit, insurance, pensions, and investment opportunities over the past decade.
The country has moved beyond universal bank account ownership towards active participation in the formal financial system.
This transformation has empowered millions of households, entrepreneurs, and businesses.

national_news.title: India's Infrastructure Transformation: From Connectivity to Capacity
bullets: Public capital expenditure has risen from about ₹2 lakh crore in FY 2014–15 to ₹12.2 lakh crore in FY
Infrastructure development has moved towards integrated planning and large-scale expansion.
This has strengthened connectivity, improved access to essential services and created the foundations for sustained economic growth.

national_news.title: Reforming India's Tribunal System
bullets: The Tribunals Reforms Bill, 2026 aims to create a more independent, transparent, and professionally administered tribunal system.
A judiciary-led National Tribunals Commission will be set up to make selections to the tribunals and exercise oversight on their functioning.
The Bill seeks to reduce executive discretion while strengthening accountability in the tribunal system.

national_news.title: India's Agriculture and Allied Sectors Witnessing Transformation
bullets: Agriculture remains the backbone of India's economy, providing livelihoods to approximately 46.1 percent of the workforce.
Livestock and fisheries have maintained stable growth of 5-6 percent, strengthening rural incomes and supporting agricultural diversification.
Over the past decade, sustained policy initiatives have driven agricultural transformation, marked by rising productivity and stronger farmer support systems.

national_news.title: BRICS nations need stronger frameworks to mobilise private capital at scale: Nirmala Sitharaman
bullets: BRICS economies need to build greater confidence, stability, predictability, and credible long-term frameworks to unlock sustained private capital flows at scale.
Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman highlighted the role of multilateral development banks in de-risking investments.
The move aims to mobilize private capital at scale in BRICS nations.

national_news.title: Government of India Strengthens India's Health System for Affordable and Accessible Healthcare
bullets: The Government of India has strengthened India's health system over the past 12 years, making quality healthcare more accessible, affordable, and equitable.
Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY) provides health insurance of Rs. 5 lakh per family per year.
The initiative aligns with the principle of 'Sabka Saath, Sabka Vikas, Sabka Vishwas and Sabka Prayas' to build an Atmanirbhar Bharat.

national_news.title: India Unveils Comprehensive National Counter Terrorism Policy & Strategy 'PRAHAAR'
bullets: PRAHAAR is India's first comprehensive National Counter Terrorism Policy & Strategy.
It provides a national counter-terrorism framework for prevention and responding to terrorist activities and radicalization.
The strategy is based on three pillars: prevention of terror attacks, swift and proportionate responses, and addressing radicalization.

national_news.title: Vibrant Villages Programme-II Approved by Central Government
bullets: Vibrant Villages Programme-II approved as Central Sector Scheme with a total outlay of ₹6839 crores till 2028-29.
Programme aims for comprehensive development of select villages in 46 blocks abutting northern border in five states/UTs.
Vibrant Villages Programme-I was approved as Centrally Sponsored Scheme on 15th February, 2023.

national_news.title: Vice-President flags off 'Har Ghar Tiranga Bike Rally 2026' in Delhi
bullets: Vice-President C P Radhakrishnan flagged off the 'Har Ghar Tiranga Bike Rally 2026' from Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi.
The rally is part of the ongoing Har Ghar Tiranga 2026 campaign dedicated to the National Song Vande Mataram.
Union Cabinet Ministers and Ministers of State were also present at the event.

national_news.title: PIB Hyderabad workshop seeks to dispel myths around organ donation
bullets: PIB Hyderabad organised a workshop on organ donation to highlight common myths and medical facts.
Experts stressed the importance of donor families, public awareness, and voluntary pledges.
NOTTO's Jug Jug Jiyo campaign aims to encourage organ donation.

national_news.title: NCSC to Review Union Government's Handling of Posts Reserved for Scheduled Caste Candidates
bullets: The National Commission for Scheduled Castes (NCSC) has raised concerns over filling reserved posts with unreserved candidates.
The NCSC will review the Union government's handling of posts reserved for Scheduled Caste candidates.
This move comes amid allegations of non-compliance with the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989.

national_news.title: Assam is India's third-largest rubber-producing state
bullets: Assam ranks third in rubber production in India, after Kerala and Tripura.
India is a major producer and consumer of natural rubber.
Rubber is an elastic, flexible, and resilient material produced from the rubber tree.

national_news.title: Monsoon Session of Parliament Adjourns Sine Die; 12 Bills Passed by both Houses of Parliament
bullets: The Monsoon Session, 2026 of Parliament was adjourned sine die on Thursday, the 13th of August, 2026.
12 Bills were passed by both Houses of Parliament during the session.
The session provided 19 sittings spread over a period of 25 days.

national_news.title: Ahmedabad Metro Phase Three Secures PIB Clearance
bullets: Ahmedabad Metro Phase Three has secured clearance from the Public Investment Board (PIB).
This development is a significant step forward for the project's construction.
The Ahmedabad Metro is a major infrastructure project aimed at improving transportation in the city.

national_news.title: Cumulative exports (merchandise & services) during April-July 2026-27 estimated at US$ 316.42 Billion
bullets: Estimated growth of 13.16% compared to April-July 2025-26
Cumulative value of merchandise exports during April-July 2026-27 was US$ 173.78 Billion, registering a positive growth of 17.04%
Cumulative Non-Petroleum exports in April-July 2026-27 valued at US$ 143.61 Billion registered an increase of 12.79%

national_news.title: India and SACU Sign Terms of Reference for Preferential Trade Agreement
bullets: India and the Southern African Customs Union (SACU) signed Terms of Reference (ToR) for negotiations towards a Preferential Trade Agreement.
Union Minister Shri Piyush Goyal called for a balanced and equitable India–SACU Trade Agreement.
The negotiations will cover eight important chapters, including trade in goods, market access for goods, and rules of origin.

national_news.title: PAC's Retrospective Examination of Defence Offsets Seems Odd
bullets: The Public Accounts Committee (PAC) has raised questions about the government's defence offset policy.
The policy is being quietly abandoned by the government, raising questions about parliamentary attention.
Union Defence Minister Rajnath Singh is at the center of the controversy.

national_news.title: India Building Capabilities in Semiconductor and AI Technologies
bullets: India is building capabilities in semiconductor design and fabrication, computing infrastructure, and indigenous AI models.
Government initiatives are being implemented across both semiconductor and AI technologies to drive growth and leadership.
Semiconductors are the foundation of modern technology, powering various sectors including smartphones, vehicles, satellites, and AI systems.

national_news.title: President Murmu presents Sangeet Natak Akademi fellowships, awards to over 100 artists
bullets: President Droupadi Murmu conferred the Sangeet Natak Akademi Fellowships and Sangeet Natak Akademi Awards on eminent artists for 2024 and 2025.
The ceremony took place at Vigyan Bhawan in Delhi.
Over 100 artists received the fellowships and awards.

national_news.title: President of India Presents Sangeet Natak Akademi Fellowships and Awards for 2024 and 2025
bullets: President Droupadi Murmu presented Sangeet Natak Akademi Fellowships and Awards to eminent artists for the year 2024 and 2025.
The artists are considered bearers of Indian tradition and guardians of collective memory, as well as creators of India's vision for the future.
The ceremony took place in New Delhi on August 13, 2026.

national_news.title: Organ donation gives new lease of life: Dr Sree Bhushan Raju
bullets: Organ donation is a noble act that gives a new lease of life to individuals in need of transplants.
Dr Sree Bhushan Raju is promoting organ donation and its importance in saving lives.
Organ donation is a crucial aspect of healthcare and social welfare in India.

national_news.title: Stage set for 80th Independence Day Celebrations at Red Fort
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi will lead the 80th Independence Day Celebrations from the Red Fort in Delhi on August 15, 2026.
The grand event will commemorate 150 years of 'Vande Mataram' and 'Yuva Shakti for Viksit Bharat@2047'.
'Vande Mataram' will be rendered for the first time as part of the celebrations.

national_news.title: India's Energy Journey: Expanding Capacity, Strengthening Security
bullets: India's energy landscape is evolving to meet rising demand while strengthening energy security and supporting a cleaner future.
The transformation spans renewable energy, nuclear power, petroleum, natural gas, coal and emerging technologies.
India is simultaneously expanding non-fossil energy capacity, strengthening domestic energy resources and developing new technologies for the future.

bihar_news.title: Bihar CM Inspects Proposed Medical College Site, Offers Guidance
bullets: Bihar CM inspected the proposed site for Maa Thawe Medical College and Hospital in Gopalganj district.
The CM offered necessary directions for the project's progress.
He also performed puja at the Thawe temple and prayed for the state's prosperity, peace, and happiness.
